template: We fit a Gaussian location-scale model to {n_obs} observations of {response}{response_units_clause} using the {package} package (version {package_version}) in R. The mean of {response} was modelled as a linear function of {mu_predictors_clause}. The residual standard deviation was modelled on the log scale as a function of {sigma_predictors_clause}.{re_clause} Parameters were estimated by maximum likelihood via the Template Model Builder framework. We report 95% {ci_method} confidence intervals on the fixed-effect coefficients.

We fit a bivariate Gaussian location-scale-correlation model to {n_obs} paired observations of {response_1} and {response_2}{response_units_clause} using the {package} package (version {package_version}) in R. The means of the two responses were modelled as linear functions of {mu1_predictors_clause} and {mu2_predictors_clause} respectively. The residual standard deviations of the two responses were modelled on the log scale ({sigma1_predictors_clause}; {sigma2_predictors_clause}). The residual correlation between the two responses was modelled on the Fisher-z scale ({rho12_predictors_clause}).{re_clause} Parameters were estimated by maximum likelihood via the Template Model Builder framework. We report 95% {ci_method} confidence intervals on the fixed-effect coefficients.

We fit a generalized linear latent variable model (GLLVM) with a Gaussian response to {n_obs} trait measurements across {n_units} {unit_word} using the {package} package (version {package_version}) in R. {n_traits} traits were modelled jointly with {n_latents} latent {axes_word} capturing between-{unit_word} covariation; trait-specific between-{unit_word} variance was estimated alongside the within-{unit_word} residual standard deviation. Parameters were estimated by maximum likelihood via the Template Model Builder framework. We report 95% {ci_method} confidence intervals on the fixed-effect coefficients.
